newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices mixed, demand declines.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices mixed, demand declines.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were mixed amid reduced general demand at the weekly export auction, auction officials said on Monday.

Brighter medium BP1s were mostly up by four U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s were irregular. Lower medium BP1s and plainer neat leaf descriptions were barely steady, while lower medium PF1s sold at about last levels. Brighter PDusts were irregularly dearer with selected lines rising by up to 10 cents.
In the secondary catalogues, fannings met selective enquiry and were generally discounted.
Pakistan lent good support and Britain was more selective.
